# Example Output — AI Social Content Pipeline

*Generated by applying the AI Social Content Pipeline skill to `example-input.md`.*

---

## 1. Pipeline map

| Stage | Automated | Writes | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| Topic pick | yes | `drafts/<date>.json` | — |
| Draft | yes | same file, validated | ~$0.35 |
| Fact-check | yes | edits `summary`, `claims[]` | ~$0.25 |
| Risk screen | yes | `risk` + `hold_reason` | — |
| Render | yes | `out/<date>.png` | — |
| Publish | yes (held posts skipped) | platform | — |

Measured cost per published post: **~$0.60**. Drafts persist between stages, so every stage boundary is also a validation boundary.

## 2. Validation rules

- `summary`: `max_length=280`; `claims`: list, 1–5 items; `topic`: non-empty.
- **Root cause of the crash:** the fact-check stage used `draft.model_copy(update={"summary": new})`, which skips validation, so a 340-character summary was written and every later `load_drafts()` raised on it.
- Fix: every automated edit goes through `Draft.model_validate(draft.model_dump() | {"summary": new})`.
- `load_drafts()` now skips and logs an unreadable file rather than raising — one bad draft no longer stops the day's run.

## 3. Risk classifier

Stems with an explicit inflection list, matched as whole words:

| Stem | Matches | Must not match |
|---|---|---|
| `die` | die, dies, died, dying | San **Die**go |
| `kill` | kill, kills, killed, killing | — |
| `minor` | minor, minors | **minor**ity |
| `investigate` | investigate, investigated | **investigat**ion (routine news) |

`test_risk.py` asserts these four false positives stay unflagged — the San Diego post now passes. The "named individual's death" rule stays a hard hold, unchanged.

## 4. Render rules

- Acronym list checked **before** casing, matching whole hyphenated tokens: `GLP-1`, `COVID-19`, `HbA1c`, `BMI`.
- Any uppercase token containing a digit is left untouched — catches `F1` and `5G` without listing them.
- Gradient fills pasted per word over `font.getbbox()`, not the line box, so the `Group` descender renders in full.

## 5. Image brief template

```text
<subject>, named vivid colours (teal, coral, warm cream),
three depth layers (foreground <object>, midground <object>, background <object>),
at least five concrete objects in frame,
natural daylight, high colour saturation
Negative: sepia, brown cast, empty background, minimalist, dark, moody
Look: <rotated from [clinical-bright, kitchen-table, outdoor-walk, lab-detail]>, excluding the last 5 posts
```

Renderer change: the 70% full-frame darkening is replaced by a rounded panel behind the text block only, at 55% opacity. The rest of the image keeps its colour.

## 6. Cost model

- Estimate written in a `finally` block, so a crashed run still books its spend.
- Reconciliation at every top-up: compare the tracker's total against the provider balance and write the delta as a correction entry — this is what would have surfaced the $6 vs $1.93 gap on day two.
- Provider auto-reload enabled at a $10 floor so the daily job cannot stall on credit.
- Forward budget: ~$0.60/post × 21 posts/month ≈ **$13/month**.
